summary: Clears/sets a file's read-only attribute through ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API (flag 128) and then attempts to delete the file via FileDeleteWithErrorHandling. Returns true (1) when the delete reported success (return value 0), false otherwise.

operations.description: Call ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API(lpFileName, 128): toggles the read-only attribute before the deletion attempt.
Call FileDeleteWithErrorHandling(lpFileName) to delete the file; returns 0 on success.
Return (deleteResult == 0): true when the file was deleted successfully.
